Our selection criteria further enriched for specimens with UTIs: only samples positive for at least two of the three following tests were accepted: leukocyte esterase activity, nitrite presence, microscopically assessed the presence of bacteria.

sample_source.evidence: 12 urine samples from 6 individuals (2 time points each) enrolled in a study on healthy aging were collected.

Thirty-three clinical specimens were from the pathology laboratory of Shady Grove Adventist Hospital (SGAH) in Rockville, Maryland, where urinalysis tests had been ordered by physicians for diagnostic purposes.
